generators.reads: Reads topic configuration intervention_terms, intervention_class_terms, include.intervention_any and include.population_any, plus comparator title/abstract. Does not read a comparator PICO object or compare comparator, outcome or design axes. Population matching is keyword presence; intervention matching is asymmetric.
Constructs review.comparator.scope from the protocol configuration and comparator bibliographic title/abstract. An invalid-scope override can force a negative verdict.

Reads review.comparator.scope.scope_valid, note, intervention-level fields and population_match. Directly trusts scope_valid. This block renders before comparator_panel.render, so having a held-document panel does not replace or validate this verdict.

number_change_why: The minimal correction changes scope metadata, verdicts and explanatory wording. It requires no changes to estimates, CIs, counts, k, trial membership or pooling, and introduces no new numeric outputs. This is a proposed correction; no files were modified.
fix: Replace scope.assess's title/abstract heuristic with a shared deterministic comparison of our protocol PICO and the comparator's independently source-backed PICO. Store each axis as MATCH, DIFFERENT or UNKNOWN, with its evidence. Require all five axes to be MATCH before scope_valid=True; use symmetric intervention-level equality. Render SCOPE MISMATCH for a known difference and SCOPE UNKNOWN for incomplete evidence. Missing comparator PICO must fail closed. Have page._comparator use the shared derivation rather than trusting a legacy scope_valid=True flag. Wire the comparator PICO through build_review_core; do not infer it by copying ours. Static inputs: protocol definitions, axis schema and source-backed comparator PICO. Dynamic outputs: axis comparisons, aggregate verdict and explanation. Keep numeric calculations and evidence membership unchanged.
plant: Proposed test: test_missing_comparator_pico_cannot_render_same_question. Build config={'intervention_terms':['colchicine'],'include':{'population_any':['pericarditis'],'intervention_any':['colchicine'],'comparator_any':['placebo'],'design_double_blind':True},'primary_outcome':{'name':'Recurrent pericarditis'}}. Set title='Colchicine for pericarditis: systematic review'; build review={'comparator':{'name':title,'scope':assess(config,title,'')}} with no comparator PICO. Exact assertions: assert review['comparator']['scope']['scope_valid'] is False; markup=_comparator(review,False); assert 'same question.' not in markup. Read-only execution confirmed today's assessor returns True and today's renderer violates the latter assertion. After the fix, absent comparator PICO must satisfy both assertions. Extend coverage with a complete matching PICO, then independently change or remove each of the five axes: only the complete all-MATCH case may render the affirmative verdict.
